sentences.zh: 哈里·里德确实在寻找一个独立的人，一个不完全

sentences.en: enmeshed in this whole world and can see, hopefully, things a little bit more clearly.
sentences.zh: 陷入这个圈子、希望能更清晰地看清局势的独立专家。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren was different.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦与众不同。

sentences.en: She was an academic.
sentences.zh: 她是一位学者。

sentences.en: She had studied the financial world and had an insight into it that others didn't have.
sentences.zh: 她研究过金融界，并对它有着别人所没有的洞察力。

sentences.en: She had a different insight than people who were actually in the business community, and they were, in some ways, significantly different.
sentences.zh: 她与那些真正身处商界的人有着不同的见解，在某些方面，这种差异非常显著。

sentences.en: I had no idea.
sentences.zh: 我当时完全没头绪。

sentences.en: I didn't even know what this particular thing was, this little regulatory thing that he was asking me to do.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道他让我做的这个所谓的监管小事到底是什么。

sentences.en: But my view was, our country's in a crisis.
sentences.zh: 但我的观点是，国家正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: And so I said, yes.
sentences.zh: 所以我答应了。

sentences.en: My view was, oh, this could be cool.
sentences.zh: 我的想法是，噢，这可能会很有意思。

sentences.en: I'm going to have authority to be able to come in and say to the
sentences.zh: 我将拥有权力，能够走进去对

sentences.en: Treasury Department and to the Fed, I want to see your numbers, and I want to see your plan.
sentences.zh: 财政部和美联储说，我要看你们的数据，我要看你们的计划。

sentences.en: I want to see where this $700 billion that Congress had authorized.
sentences.zh: 我想看看国会授权的那7000亿美元到底去了哪里。

sentences.en: I want to see where that money is going and what you're getting in return, what kind of promises and changes from the banks.
sentences.zh: 我想知道钱花在哪儿了，你们得到了什么回报，银行又做出了什么样的承诺和改变。

sentences.en: And so I'm thinking, ah, we're going to do this, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，啊，我们要大干一场了，对吧？

sentences.en: So that night, I sat down and actually looked up the statute that authorized this congressional oversight panel.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我坐下来仔细查阅了授权成立这个国会监督小组的法规。

sentences.en: And it had some stuff about how people get appointed and how they get paid and so on.
sentences.zh: 里面写了一些关于人员如何任命、如何支付薪酬等等的内容。

sentences.en: And then it just says, we'll write reports every 30 days.
sentences.zh: 然后它只是说，我们每30天写一份报告。

sentences.en: And I thought, whoa, what?
sentences.zh: 我心想，哇，什么？

sentences.en: So I kind of have this moment of, I'm still going to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时有过那么一瞬间的迟疑，但我还是决定要做。

sentences.en: I'll do whatever I've been asked to do.
sentences.zh: 无论被要求做什么，我都会去做。

sentences.en: But I thought, okay, they gave me one tool.
sentences.zh: 但我心想，好吧，他们给了我一件工具。

sentences.en: Write reports.
sentences.zh: 写报告。

sentences.en: I'll write reports.
sentences.zh: 那我就写报告。

sentences.en: And that's what I started doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是我开始做的事情。

sentences.en: I write these reports every 30 days.
sentences.zh: 我每30天写一份报告。

sentences.en: I get my panel together.
sentences.zh: 我召集我的小组成员。

sentences.en: There are five of us all together.
sentences.zh: 我们总共五个人。

sentences.en: I'm the chair.
sentences.zh: 我是主席。

sentences.en: And man, we just tear into it.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们真是铆足了劲去钻研。

sentences.en: But here was the thing.
sentences.zh: 但重点在于。

sentences.en: This was important to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我很重要。

sentences.en: This is the part I was starting to learn.
sentences.zh: 这就是我开始领悟到的部分。

sentences.en: The reports are very technical.
sentences.zh: 报告非常专业且技术性很强。

sentences.en: But the front part is always written in plain English.
sentences.zh: 但前言部分总是用通俗易懂的语言写的。

sentences.en: And then I did videos.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始制作视频。

sentences.en: I'm
sentences.zh: 我是

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren, chair of the congressional oversight panel.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦，国会监督小组主席。

sentences.en: I'm here to introduce our June oversight report.
sentences.zh: 我在这里介绍我们六月份的监督报告。

sentences.en: To explain what had happened, explain what the report's about.
sentences.zh: 解释发生了什么，解释报告的内容。

sentences.en: AIG was so seriously under-regulated that although 400 agencies were supposed to keep an eye on it, nobody had a complete picture.
sentences.zh: 美国国际集团（AIG）的监管缺失极其严重，尽管有400家机构本应监管它，但没人能掌握全貌。

sentences.en: And explain what our recommendations are.
sentences.zh: 并解释我们的建议是什么。

sentences.en: The rescue of
sentences.zh: 对

sentences.en: AIG continues to have a poisonous effect on the marketplace.
sentences.zh: AIG的救援行动继续对市场产生毒害作用。

sentences.en: And just kept doing it every 30 days.
sentences.zh: 我就这样每30天坚持做下去。

sentences.en: By providing a complete rescue that called for no shared sacrifice among AIG and its creditors, the government fundamentally changed the rules of the game on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 通过提供一项不需要AIG及其债权人共同分担牺牲的全面救援，政府从根本上改变了华尔街的游戏规则。

sentences.en: So she's doing these reports and making these videos.
sentences.zh: 所以她一直在写报告、拍视频。

sentences.en: And they're getting some traction.
sentences.zh: 而且这些内容开始产生了一些影响。

sentences.en: But obviously, there's a limited audience for these things.
sentences.zh: 但显然，这些东西的受众有限。

sentences.en: And they're clear, but they're not exactly must-watch TV.
sentences.zh: 它们虽然清晰易懂，但算不上那种必看的电视节目。

sentences.en: So what I mostly am doing in those months is just explaining what went wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以那几个月我主要做的事情就是解释哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: My job was to say, no, it is not too complicated to understand.
sentences.zh: 我的工作就是说，不，这并不复杂，完全可以理解。

sentences.en: Here's exactly what happened.
sentences.zh: 事情的真相就是这样。

sentences.en: Finally, that story lands a big audience.
sentences.zh: 最终，那个故事吸引了大量的观众。

sentences.en: The story you told on John Seward Show.
sentences.zh: 你在约翰·斯图尔特节目里讲的那个故事。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Welcome back to Morning Joe.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《早安乔》节目。

sentences.en: And here with us now, the chair of the Congressional Oversight
sentences.zh: 现在和我们在一起的是国会监督

sentences.en: Panel and professor at Harvard Law School, Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 小组主席、哈佛法学院教授伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: And it gets her this big public platform.
sentences.zh: 这让她获得了巨大的公众平台。

sentences.en: Harvard professor Elizabeth Warren.
sentences.zh: 哈佛教授伊丽莎白·沃伦。

sentences.en: We'll hear from her in just a moment.
sentences.zh: 稍后我们将听听她的看法。

sentences.en: Harper Oversight Panel Chair Elizabeth Warren is going to join us live.
sentences.zh: 国会监督小组主席伊丽莎白·沃伦即将加入我们的直播。

sentences.en: She's going to be joining us live.
sentences.zh: 她马上就要加入我们的直播了。

sentences.en: Welcome, Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，伊丽莎白。

sentences.en: Appreciate you joining us.
sentences.zh: 感谢你能来。

sentences.en: I'm always glad to be here.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来这里。

sentences.en: Professor Warren, thanks very much for joining us again.
sentences.zh: 沃伦教授，非常感谢您再次加入我们。

sentences.en: Will you win for president in 2012, please?
sentences.zh: 您能参加2012年的总统竞选吗，拜托？

sentences.en: It would be helpful.
sentences.zh: 那会有帮助的。

sentences.en: I have to go teach class in two hours.
sentences.zh: 我两小时后还得去上课。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: That she then uses to advocate for what some believe to be radical regulatory shifts in the system.
sentences.zh: 她随后利用这个平台，倡导了一些人认为在体制内激进的监管变革。

sentences.en: Much tougher protections for consumers, much tougher rules governing Wall Street, and a stronger watchdog overseeing it all.
sentences.zh: 为消费者提供更强有力的保护，制定更严格的华尔街管理规则，并建立一个更强大的监管机构来监督这一切。

sentences.en: And a lot of people applauded that, but others thought it was crazy.
sentences.zh: 很多人为此鼓掌，但也有人觉得这简直是疯了。

sentences.en: I think Elizabeth Warren, in some ways, became the boogeywoman.
sentences.zh: 我认为伊丽莎白·沃伦在某种程度上成了人们眼中的“女魔头”。

sentences.en: Wall Street hates her.
sentences.zh: 华尔街恨透了她。

sentences.en: Her name is like a dirty word on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 在华尔街，她的名字就像个脏字。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember calling up bank CEOs at that time, and if I mentioned the name Elizabeth Warren,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得当时给银行首席执行官们打电话，如果我提到伊丽莎白·沃伦这个名字，

sentences.en: you know, they might have dropped the phone on me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们可能会直接挂断我的电话。

sentences.en: There was an incredible amount of anxiety, right?
sentences.zh: 当时有一种难以置信的焦虑感，对吧？

sentences.en: People like Robert Wolfe, the CEO at the time of the American arm of UBS, the largest Swiss bank.
sentences.zh: 像罗伯特·沃尔夫这样的人，时任瑞士最大银行瑞银集团（UBS）美国分部的首席执行官。

sentences.en: And there was just an unknown.
sentences.zh: 当时充满了未知。

sentences.en: And I think that this just brought a new unknown to it with kind of a new sheriff in town.
sentences.zh: 我认为这带来了一个新的未知因素，就像城里来了个新警长。

sentences.en: And Elizabeth Warren was a smart sheriff.
sentences.zh: 而伊丽莎白·沃伦是一位聪明的警长。

sentences.en: She was a passionate sheriff.
sentences.zh: 她是一位充满激情的警长。

sentences.en: And she had a plan that she's been talking about unbeknownst to us at that time for years.
sentences.zh: 她有一个当时我们并不知晓、但她已经筹划多年的计划。

sentences.en: She was advocating for a complete rethink of the banking system.
sentences.zh: 她主张对银行体系进行彻底的重构。

sentences.en: And that was anathema to the bankers.
sentences.zh: 这对银行家们来说是深恶痛绝的。

sentences.en: Because it would have fundamentally rewritten the rules.
sentences.zh: 因为这会从根本上改写规则。

sentences.en: It would have meant that most of these people wouldn't even have jobs when it was over.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当这一切结束时，这些人中的大多数人甚至可能保不住饭碗。

sentences.en: Most of the bank CEOs felt that she was very smart.
sentences.zh: 大多数银行首席执行官都觉得她非常聪明。

sentences.en: She was very passionate.
sentences.zh: 她非常有激情。

sentences.en: But she's never been there, done that.
sentences.zh: 但她从来没有过相关从业经验。

sentences.en: There was no question that they were nervous that she would take her passion and angst and then drive home these rules that no one was sure at the time whether they would be
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他们很紧张，担心她会带着激情和焦虑去推行这些规则，而当时没人确定这些规则到底是

sentences.en: helpful or hurtful.
sentences.zh: 有益还是有害。

sentences.en: So it was clear to me that in many ways, people were either scared of her or disliked her or felt like, you know, you've never really been there.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，在很多方面，人们要么怕她，要么讨厌她，要么觉得，你根本没干过这一行，懂什么？

sentences.en: So what do you know about it?
sentences.zh: 所以你对此了解多少？

sentences.en: So what is your overarching goal at this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么你目前的首要目标是什么？

sentences.en: What are you envisioning that you can get done in this corner of the regulatory oversight system in the middle of its financial crisis?
sentences.zh: 在金融危机期间，你设想在监管监督体系的这个角落里能完成什么？

sentences.en: I started thinking this is a great moment to make government work again for the people instead of working for the big banks.
sentences.zh: 我开始认为这是一个绝佳的时机，让政府重新为人民服务，而不是为大银行服务。

sentences.en: I think of it as the fire, the crash of 2008 is enough that everyone will lift their heads and said, oh my God, we need to put the rules back in place.
sentences.zh: 我把它看作是一场火灾，2008年的崩盘足以让每个人都抬起头来说，天哪，我们需要把规则重新建立起来。

sentences.en: We need to get this system back on track.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让这个体系回到正轨。

sentences.en: We need to make capitalism work, not just for the rich, not use it as an instrument for theft.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让资本主义发挥作用，不仅仅是为了富人，也不能把它当作盗窃的工具。

sentences.en: We need to make this work for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们需要让它为每个人服务。

sentences.en: So it's about, for me, it's about watching what's happening now as you're trying to steady the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，重点在于观察在你们试图稳定经济的同时正在发生什么。

sentences.en: But I'm very focused on what's going to come next.
sentences.zh: 但我非常关注接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Warren seeing this as the fire that should convince everybody that big changes needed to be implemented immediately, like now in the moment, there's no time to let up.
sentences.zh: 所以沃伦把这看作是一场火灾，应该让所有人相信必须立即实施重大变革，就是现在，刻不容缓。

sentences.en: We got to do it.
sentences.zh: 我们必须行动起来。

sentences.en: And in theory, most Democrats agreed with her on the big ideas.
sentences.zh: 理论上，大多数民主党人在大方向上都同意她的观点。

sentences.en: But when it came to the tactics and the timing, not so much.
sentences.zh: 但谈到策略和时机时，就不那么一致了。

sentences.en: There wasn't great enthusiasm for Elizabeth among the economic team.
sentences.zh: 经济团队对伊丽莎白并没有表现出太大的热情。

sentences.en: People inside the Obama administration, senior people like David Axelrod will say they kind of saw her as a thorn in their side.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府内部的人，像大卫·阿克塞尔罗德这样的高级官员会说，他们把她视为眼中钉。

sentences.en: They saw her as a relentless opponent of the financial industry at a time that they were trying to prop the financial industry up.
sentences.zh: 他们认为她在他们试图支撑金融业的时候，却成了金融业无情的反对者。

sentences.en: Tim Geiter, who was the secretary of Treasury at the time, hardly could get along with her and fundamentally disagreed with her about what the solution should really be.
sentences.zh: 时任财政部长的蒂姆·盖特纳几乎无法与她相处，并且在解决方案到底应该是什么的问题上与她存在根本分歧。

sentences.en: Inside the administration, we literally feared a second Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 在政府内部，我们确实担心会发生第二次大萧条。

sentences.en: And the thing that would have triggered it would have been the collapse of the financial system.
sentences.zh: 而引发这一切的导火索将是金融体系的崩溃。

sentences.en: And that was not out of the question.
sentences.zh: 这并非不可能发生。

sentences.en: So we were left to try and undergird the financial system while she wanted to prosecute it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能试图支撑金融体系，而她却想对它进行起诉。

sentences.en: And, you know, the feeling among the economic team was that this was deeply unhelpful at a time when we had a real crisis and that there may be a time and place for that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，经济团队的感觉是，在我们面临真正危机的时候，这非常无益，也许以后会有时间和场合来做这些事。

sentences.en: But first put out the fire.
sentences.zh: 但首先得把火扑灭。

sentences.en: Secretary Geiter's position at that time under President Obama was to try to figure out a way to put as many people back to work and to invigorate the economy as quickly as humanly possible to save the system.
sentences.zh: 盖特纳部长当时在奥巴马总统领导下的立场是，设法找出一种方法，让尽可能多的人重返工作岗位，并以最快的速度激活经济，以拯救这个体系。

sentences.en: Her view was, I'm going to blow up the system and it will be a better system in the long term.
sentences.zh: 她的观点是，我要炸掉这个体系，从长远来看，它会变成一个更好的体系。

sentences.en: And if there's some collateral damage along the way or this crisis lasts longer, that might be an OK outcome.
sentences.zh: 如果过程中会有一些附带损害，或者危机持续时间更长，那也许是可以接受的结果。

sentences.en: Politically, though, President Obama didn't have that time.
sentences.zh: 然而在政治上，奥巴马总统没有那么多时间。

sentences.en: Hey, Elizabeth, you've got Tim Geiter, Secretary Geiter in front of your oversight panel tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伊丽莎白，明天盖特纳部长就要在你的监督小组面前作证了。

sentences.en: What is the one question you want answered on behalf of the American people?
sentences.zh: 你代表美国人民最想得到的一个问题的答案是什么？

sentences.en: Oh, I still want to know where'd the money go?
sentences.zh: 噢，我还是想知道钱去哪儿了？

sentences.en: Warren would haul Geiter up to Capitol Hill over and over to testify in front of her panel.
sentences.zh: 沃伦会一次又一次地把盖特纳传唤到国会山，在她的监督小组面前作证。

sentences.en: This hearing is called to order.
sentences.zh: 现在开庭。

sentences.en: Thank you for being here today, Mr. Secretary.
sentences.zh: 感谢您今天到场，部长先生。

sentences.en: AIG has received about $70 billion in TARP money, about $100 billion in loans from the Fed.
sentences.zh: AIG已经收到了大约700亿美元的救助资金，以及大约1000亿美元来自美联储的贷款。

sentences.en: Do you know where the money went?
sentences.zh: 你知道钱都去哪了吗？

sentences.en: And just grill him, laying into him about how the administration was handling the bailout.
sentences.zh: 然后对他严加盘问，痛斥政府处理救市资金的方式。

sentences.en: And so now I'm caught in the question of what is your metric for success here?
sentences.zh: 所以现在我陷入了一个问题：你们衡量成功的标准到底是什么？

sentences.en: You believe we have a sense of how much is left in the way of toxic assets on their books?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们清楚他们账面上还剩下多少有毒资产吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然清楚。

sentences.en: Do we have a dollar figure for that?
sentences.zh: 我们有具体的金额吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to be happy to...
sentences.zh: 嗯，我很乐意……

sentences.en: Does Treasury plan to do that?
sentences.zh: 财政部打算这样做吗？

sentences.en: How do you deal with that problem, Mr. Secretary?
sentences.zh: 部长先生，你打算如何处理这个问题？

sentences.en: I'm usually finished.
sentences.zh: 我通常已经说完了。

sentences.en: So where are you going?
sentences.zh: 那你打算去哪？

sentences.en: What would you like to know?
sentences.zh: 你想知道什么？

sentences.en: I just want to know.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道。

sentences.en: I'm basically suggesting they weren't being tough enough on the banks.
sentences.zh: 我其实是在暗示他们对银行不够强硬。

sentences.en: Mr. Secretary, I'm familiar with all that you think you've done to support housing overall.
sentences.zh: 部长先生，我很清楚你认为自己在支持住房市场方面所做的一切。

sentences.en: The question is, camp is designed...
sentences.zh: 问题是，这个阵营的设计初衷是……

sentences.en: So you have these sort of competing forces at work.
sentences.zh: 所以你面临着这些相互冲突的力量。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren had a philosophical view about what the system should look like in the future.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦对未来体制应该是什么样子有着自己的哲学观点。

sentences.en: And Secretary Geithner and the Obama team would tell you they had a very grounded, realistic, on-the-ground view of we need to get people back to work right now.
sentences.zh: 而盖特纳部长和奥巴马团队会告诉你，他们有着非常务实、接地气的观点，即我们需要立刻让人们重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: And if we completely blow up the system, we have no idea what's on the other side.
sentences.zh: 如果我们彻底摧毁这个体制，我们根本不知道后果会怎样。

sentences.en: So it put us in a bind because, on the one hand, we couldn't allow these institutions to collapse because the whole economy would totally collapse with it.
sentences.zh: 这让我们陷入了困境，因为一方面，我们不能让这些机构倒闭，否则整个经济也会随之彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, by stepping in to try and make sure they didn't collapse, we looked, you know, vaguely complicit.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，通过介入以确保它们不倒闭，我们看起来，你知道，有点像是同谋。

sentences.en: And so having Elizabeth out there banging that drum, you know, added to the difficult atmospherics.
sentences.zh: 所以让伊丽莎白在那儿敲边鼓，你知道，加剧了这种困难的氛围。

sentences.en: You know, her rhetoric was inflammatory to a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她的言论对很多人来说具有煽动性。

sentences.en: So here's the thing about Elizabeth Warren, as this is happening.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于伊丽莎白·沃伦，在这一切发生时，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: She understands the position of the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 她理解奥巴马政府的立场。

sentences.en: She gets the conundrum that they face.
sentences.zh: 她明白他们面临的难题。

sentences.en: She gets the political forces at play.
sentences.zh: 她了解其中的政治力量博弈。

sentences.en: But she doesn't really care about being friends with Tim Geithner.
sentences.zh: 但她并不在乎是否能和蒂姆·盖特纳成为朋友。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to be friends with the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 她不想和奥巴马政府成为朋友。

sentences.en: She doesn't want to be friends with people on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 她也不想和华尔街的人成为朋友。

sentences.en: She relishes the role of being the outsider.
sentences.zh: 她很享受作为局外人的角色。

sentences.en: She's not trying to change the system from the inside.
sentences.zh: 她不是想从内部改变体制。

sentences.en: So she's willing to alienate the people who would have traditionally been her allies because she really believes she has this principled stand.
sentences.zh: 所以她宁愿疏远那些传统上的盟友，因为她坚信自己有这种原则立场。

sentences.en: And if she commits to that principled stand, her supporters won't just stick with her, but they'll grow.
sentences.zh: 如果她坚持这种原则立场，她的支持者不仅会追随她，还会越来越多。

sentences.en: There was a lot of fighting over this.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，当时有很多争论。

sentences.en: And a lot of fighting over the words you used and the approach you took.
sentences.zh: 对于你使用的措辞和采取的方法，也有很多争论。

sentences.en: David Axelrod, we spoke with, at times he sensed that how you were approaching this could be pure and right in spirit, but counterproductive in tactics.
sentences.zh: 我们采访过大卫·阿克塞尔罗德，他有时觉得你处理这件事的方式在精神上可能是纯粹且正确的，但在策略上却适得其反。

sentences.en: The word that gets used a lot to describe this period and how you are approaching these questions is that you alienated people.
sentences.zh: 描述这一时期以及你处理这些问题的方式时，人们常说的一个词是：你疏远了他人。

sentences.en: That's a word that gets used a lot.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经常被用到的词。

sentences.en: What's your reaction to that word?
sentences.zh: 你对这个词有什么反应？

sentences.en: What does that mean to you?
sentences.zh: 这对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: You know, I always heard that as you wouldn't play nice with the banks and the big donors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直听到的说法是，我不愿意和银行及大金主们好好相处。

sentences.en: And I just didn't care about the banks and the big donors.
sentences.zh: 而我根本不在乎银行和大金主。

sentences.en: If you thought I was wrong in what families needed, tell me.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为我在家庭需求方面的判断有误，请告诉我。

sentences.en: But nobody ever did.
sentences.zh: 但从来没有人这么做过。

sentences.en: You know what everybody said to me?
sentences.zh: 你知道每个人都对我说什么吗？

sentences.en: It's a great idea, but don't even try to do it because the banks call the shots.
sentences.zh: 这是个好主意，但别去尝试，因为银行说了算。

sentences.en: The big money calls the shots, and they're going to keep this from getting done.
sentences.zh: 大资本说了算，他们会阻止这件事完成。

sentences.en: And so there comes this time in 2010 when the economy is now no longer in complete freefall, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 所以到了2010年，经济至少不再处于彻底的自由落体状态。

sentences.en: The administration is now ready to act on some of these ideas of hers, including perhaps her
sentences.zh: 政府现在准备采取她的一些想法，包括她可能提出的

sentences.en: biggest idea, which was this new agency that she had conceived of called the Consumer Financial
sentences.zh: 最大的想法，即她构思的那个新机构，名为消费者金融

sentences.en: Protection Bureau.
sentences.zh: 保护局。

sentences.en: She was very clear that she wanted to lead this bureau.
sentences.zh: 她非常明确地表示她想领导这个局。

sentences.en: And she said, you know, I could do that and I'd be very enthusiastic about it.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，我可以胜任，而且我会非常有热情。

sentences.en: Or I could spend the next 10 months looking over Tim Geithner's shoulder.
sentences.zh: 或者我可以花接下来的10个月盯着蒂姆·盖特纳的一举一动。

sentences.en: So it was, you know, about as subtle as a screen door on a submarine.
sentences.zh: 所以这，你知道，就像潜水艇上的纱门一样，毫无隐晦可言。

sentences.en: You know, the message was very, very clear.
sentences.zh: 你知道，信息非常、非常明确。

sentences.en: She's basically saying, I can make your life hell by going out on TV every single day and continuing to tell everybody that I can find that you're in bed with the banks and I will.
sentences.zh: 她基本上是在说，我可以每天上电视，不断告诉所有人我发现你们和银行勾结在一起，以此让你们的日子不好过，而且我会这么做。

sentences.en: You know, I took that message to the president and he basically said, tell her to shut up, let us pass this bill, and then we can talk about this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我把这个信息带给了总统，他基本上说，告诉她闭嘴，让我们通过这个法案，然后再谈这件事。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: It has been almost three years since the financial crisis pulled the economy into a deep recession.
sentences.zh: 距离金融危机将经济拖入深度衰退已经过去近三年了。

sentences.en: He wanted to bring her in because she was the author of the idea.
sentences.zh: 他想把她拉进来，因为她是这个想法的提出者。

sentences.en: I mean, she was the most prominent promoter of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她是这个想法最突出的推动者。

sentences.en: Elizabeth was sounding the alarm on predatory lending and the financial pressures on middle class families.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白当时正在对掠夺性贷款和中产阶级家庭面临的经济压力敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And she was someone who he felt would be a very strong advocate and he wanted that.
sentences.zh: 他觉得她会是一个非常强有力的倡导者，而他需要这一点。

sentences.en: She's become perhaps the leading voice in our country on behalf of consumers.
sentences.zh: 她已经成为我国代表消费者利益的最主要声音之一。

sentences.en: But he also had to manage the politics of the financial reform.
sentences.zh: 但他也必须处理金融改革中的政治问题。

sentences.en: And let's face it, she's done it while facing some very tough opposition and drawing a fair amount of heat.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，她在面对一些非常强硬的反对和相当大的压力时做到了这一点。

sentences.en: Fortunately, she's very tough.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，她非常坚强。

sentences.en: You know, Elizabeth Warren was deeply, deeply controversial among members of Congress, among
sentences.zh: 你知道，伊丽莎白·沃伦在国会议员中，在

sentences.en: members of the Senate, not just Republicans, but Democrats who had ties to the financial industry.
sentences.zh: 参议员中，不仅是共和党人，甚至包括与金融业有联系的民主党人，都极具争议。

sentences.en: Over the past year, she has done an extraordinary job.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，她做出了非凡的贡献。

sentences.en: She was seen as an inconvenient voice out there and one who they thought was unfair in her attacks.
sentences.zh: 她被视为一个不合时宜的声音，且被认为在攻击中不够公正。

sentences.en: And there was a real resistance to her.
sentences.zh: 人们对她有着真正的抵触情绪。

sentences.en: As part of her charge, I asked Elizabeth to find the best possible choice for director of the bureau.
sentences.zh: 作为职责的一部分，我请伊丽莎白为该局局长寻找最佳人选。

sentences.en: We wanted her, but we had to navigate that.
sentences.zh: 我们想要她，但我们必须处理好其中的政治关系。

sentences.en: And that's who we found in Richard Cordray.
sentences.zh: 而理查德·科德雷就是我们找到的人选。

sentences.en: So ultimately, she's passed over.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，她被跳过了。

sentences.en: She doesn't get to run the things she created, arguably because she was so fierce in trying to advocate for it in the first place.
sentences.zh: 她没能执掌她所创立的机构，可以说正是因为她最初在倡导该机构时表现得太过强硬。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And congratulations, Richard.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你，理查德。

sentences.en: Do you ever wonder, Senator, if the things that make you such a potent communicator and storyteller and have earned you a significant base of support, made you a frontrunner in
sentences.zh: 参议员，你有没有想过，那些让你成为如此有影响力的沟通者和讲述者，并为你赢得了大量支持基础，让你在民主党初选中脱颖而出的特质，

sentences.en: the Democratic primary, that that might make it harder to actually solve the problems you've been so nimble at diagnosing and that you've devoted so much of your career to studying
sentences.zh: 是否反而让你更难解决那些你如此敏锐地诊断出来，并投入了职业生涯大部分时间去研究的问题，

sentences.en: all the way back to the 80s and 90s?
sentences.zh: 从80年代和90年代一直到现在？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: That word alienating.
sentences.zh: 那个词，疏远。

sentences.en: No, actually, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上，我并不这么认为。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you why.
sentences.zh: 我告诉你为什么。

sentences.en: Because your vision is very uncompromising.
sentences.zh: 因为你的愿景非常不妥协。

sentences.en: Because the question becomes, are you uncompromising?
sentences.zh: 因为问题变成了：你是不妥协吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not uncompromising.
sentences.zh: 不，这并不是不妥协。

sentences.en: Look, the consumer agency, for example.
sentences.zh: 你看，以消费者保护局为例。

sentences.en: Did we get everything we wanted in the consumer agency?
sentences.zh: 我们在消费者保护局中得到了我们想要的一切吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I can compromise when it's the right thing to compromise.
sentences.zh: 当妥协是正确的事情时，我可以妥协。

sentences.en: You know what I think a lot of folks are talking about on this?
sentences.zh: 你知道我认为很多人在讨论什么吗？

sentences.en: When you ask this question about kind of this get-along notion, it's how much are you going to yield to the corruption in the system?
sentences.zh: 当你问到这种“和气生财”的概念时，问题在于：你愿意向体制内的腐败让步多少？

sentences.en: The people who are handing out all the campaign contributions and they've got all the lobbyists and they've
sentences.zh: 那些发放所有竞选捐款的人，他们拥有所有的游说者，他们

sentences.en: got the bought and paid for experts whose voices they lift up and they give money to the think tanks because they like the system, how it works.
sentences.zh: 拥有那些被收买的专家，他们抬高这些人的声音，并给智库捐钱，因为他们喜欢这个体制，喜欢它的运作方式。

sentences.en: And when they can't fight back on substance, they go after the messenger.
sentences.zh: 当他们在实质问题上无法反击时，他们就去攻击传话的人。

sentences.en: And they say, oh, well, too uncompromising.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦，太不妥协了。

sentences.en: Well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 好吧，没错。

sentences.en: If the question is, do I think that Washington should be making policy based on a revolving door with Wall Street, yeah, I don't think it ought to be doing that.
sentences.zh: 如果问题是，我是否认为华盛顿应该基于与华尔街的旋转门关系来制定政策，是的，我不认为它应该这样做。

sentences.en: And we built a really great economy for decades in which that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，我们建立了一个非常棒的经济体系，其中并没有发生这种情况。

sentences.en: What I'm asking for, I believe, is ultimately quite reasonable.
sentences.zh: 我相信我所要求的最终是非常合理的。

sentences.en: The system has been broken for decades.
sentences.zh: 这个体制已经崩溃了几十年了。

sentences.en: Donald Trump has just accelerated it.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普只是加速了这一过程。

sentences.en: And now we see it big time.
sentences.zh: 现在我们看得一清二楚。

sentences.en: That means very much like following the crash of 2008, the door for real change has opened a crack.
sentences.zh: 这意味着就像2008年崩盘后一样，真正变革的大门已经打开了一条缝。

sentences.en: Now, we could just say we want to go back to business as usual, the way it was before
sentences.zh: 现在，我们可以说我们想回到一切照旧的状态，回到

sentences.en: Donald Trump came along.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普出现之前的方式。

sentences.en: But not me.
sentences.zh: 但我不会。

sentences.en: I see the door open to crack, just like it did following the financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 我看到大门打开了一条缝，就像金融危机后那样。

sentences.en: But it was hard to get through that door for you.
sentences.zh: 但对你来说，穿过那扇门很难。

sentences.en: It's not about me.
sentences.zh: 这与我无关。

sentences.en: Put down your shoulder and hit as hard as you can at that door.
sentences.zh: 用你的肩膀顶住，尽你最大的努力去撞那扇门。

sentences.en: Open it up and make the changes we need to make as a country.
sentences.zh: 把它打开，做出我们作为一个国家需要做出的改变。

sentences.en: So the big question is, if Elizabeth Warren is president, how hard is she really going to lean into that door to try to crack it open?
sentences.zh: 所以最大的问题是，如果伊丽莎白·沃伦当选总统，她会多努力地去推那扇门，试图把它撞开？

sentences.en: You know, how much is she going to stick with this principle-based view?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她会多大程度上坚持这种基于原则的观点？

sentences.en: Is she going to need help from the other side?
sentences.zh: 她需要来自另一方的帮助吗？

sentences.en: And is she willing to alienate not just the other side, but her own allies in the name of principle?
sentences.zh: 为了原则，她是否愿意疏远不仅是另一方，甚至包括她自己的盟友？

sentences.en: She's always been fighting as the outsider.
sentences.zh: 她一直是以局外人的身份在战斗。

sentences.en: And what happens once you become the insider?
sentences.zh: 一旦你成为了局内人，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Does an uncompromising vision work for a president?
sentences.zh: 不妥协的愿景对总统来说有效吗？

sentences.en: It's not about compromising.
sentences.zh: 这与妥协无关。

sentences.en: I think that's just not the key point here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这根本不是重点。

sentences.en: It's about having a vision about who you want to work for.
sentences.zh: 重点在于你要有一个愿景，明确你想为谁工作。

sentences.en: And then you make decisions as you go along.
sentences.zh: 然后你在前进的过程中做出决定。

sentences.en: There are times to compromise, but you don't start out by saying, you know what?
sentences.zh: 有时候需要妥协，但你不能一开始就说，你知道吗？

sentences.en: The people are going to oppose this.
sentences.zh: 人们会反对这个。

sentences.en: So let's just start asking for only 2%.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还是只要求2%吧。

sentences.en: That's just not the way to go about it.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是解决问题的方法。

sentences.en: You lay out the vision and say, that's where I'm going to head in this, because this is what I believe in.
sentences.zh: 你要提出愿景并说，这就是我在这件事上要前进的方向，因为这是我的信仰。

sentences.en: I believe in what we can do together.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们能一起做到的事情。

sentences.en: I believe in the America we can build.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们能建立的美国。

sentences.en: But we've got to have a vision for that.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须为此有一个愿景。

sentences.en: It can't all be about just, you know, let's do just slight changes.
sentences.zh: 不能全都是，你知道，让我们只做些微小的改变。

sentences.en: Because understand this, Republicans are going to fight us on slight changes.
sentences.zh: 因为你要明白，共和党人会在微小的改变上也与我们抗争。

sentences.en: So if you're going to be in a fight, make it a fight worth having, and make it a fight that will inspire millions of people to join.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你注定要战斗，那就打一场值得的仗，打一场能激励数百万人加入的仗。

sentences.en: I think she's signaling here that she understands that being president is different from being an advocate pushing from the outside.
sentences.zh: 我认为她在这里发出的信号是，她明白当总统与作为局外推动者的倡导者是不同的。

sentences.en: But if her brand fundamentally is to be uncompromising, if that is the brand, if the brand is to be
sentences.zh: 但如果她的品牌本质上就是不妥协，如果这就是她的品牌，如果品牌就是

sentences.en: principled, it's the thing that got her that public following in the first place.
sentences.zh: 有原则，那正是她最初获得公众追随的原因。

sentences.en: Even when she knew it was going to alienate her from some of the people closest to her.
sentences.zh: 即使她知道这会让她与身边最亲近的一些人产生隔阂。

sentences.en: What happens if she becomes president and she feels like she has to compromise?
sentences.zh: 如果她当了总统，觉得不得不妥协，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Do her supporters come with her?
sentences.zh: 她的支持者会跟随她吗？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我不想妄下定论，因为显然还有大量结果正在统计中，我们目前处理的也仅仅是预测数据。

sentences.en: In Britain's closely watched general election,
sentences.zh: 在备受瞩目的英国大选中，

sentences.en: Prime Minister Boris Johnson appeared to be headed for a major victory that would allow him to fulfill his promise of pulling the UK out of the European Union by the end of January.
sentences.zh: 首相鲍里斯·约翰逊似乎正迈向一场重大胜利，这将使他能够兑现承诺，在1月底前带领英国脱离欧盟。

sentences.en: And not just to get Brexit done, but to unite this country and to take it forward and to focus on the priorities of the British people.
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了完成脱欧，更是为了团结这个国家，推动它向前发展，并专注于英国人民的优先事项。

sentences.en: Exit polls, conducted by three major British broadcasters, projected that Johnson's Conservative Party would win an 86-seat majority in the House of Commons,
sentences.zh: 由英国三大广播公司进行的出口民调显示，约翰逊领导的保守党预计将在下议院赢得86个席位的多数优势，

sentences.en: an outcome that extinguishes the possibility that Britain might somehow remain in the EU.
sentences.zh: 这一结果彻底终结了英国可能以某种方式留在欧盟的可能性。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。
